name: Kiefer
prior: Jaw Harp Synth (iOS, 2025): 'first physics-based jaw harp synthesizer', modelled on the Yakutian khomus, morphs 5 vowels on an XY pad, 3-band formant filter, velocity plucking, drum pads (VS: apps.apple.com/app/id6758465213) = the mouth-as-XY-pad idea exists on phones, apparently without a note grid, Höhe or tilt mapping. Jaw Harp App (I. Baichurin) and Mouth Harp (A. Leach): iPhone apps where lips/tongue position changes the timbre (VS: apps.apple.com/us/app/id6475697255, id376563785). Magic Jaw Harps (Kontakt, samples): mouth overtones on the mod wheel, playable chromatically over 6 octaves (VS: kvraudio / rekkerd listing). Acoustics: Adkins 1974 (JASA) - the lamella excites the mouth with short pulses as it passes the frame; with the mouth tuned high the perceived pitch is the mouth resonance and 'may be tuned continuously' (VS: labs.sonicfield.org library entry) - supports the design (mouth harmonic is the melody). No DAFx/NIME/ICMC waveguide model found in search. Myzel: Obertöne (held harmonic spotlight on a pressed voice, APP 4004), Kalimba (tine). Not found: a touch instrument that puts the mouth harmonic on finger height over a bordun, with tilt as mouth and a sequencer lane plucking khomus riffs.
costNotes: Native: 2 oscillators 0.12 + noise source 0.06 + 3 biquads 0.18 + ~5 gains 0.15 = ~0.5 at L1 (R: webaudio.md section 4; the idea's 0.45 is close). L3 two tongues L/R + nasal formant ~1.0. Automation per note: 2 setTargetAtTime for the closing lowpass, 1 setValueAtTime+1 setTargetAtTime for the envelope, mouth frequency setP on every setY (touch move ~60/s, each a setTargetAtTime; same rate Nebel already uses on its filter, APP neb.setY). No feedback path, so no worklet; the 'Schnarr-Shaper' (WaveShaper, oversample none) would be +0.06.
soundHeld: The held note is a contradiction as written: no sustain, so after nachklang the mouth has nothing to filter (envelope setTargetAtTime(0, t, nachklang/6.9) is -40 dB after 1.07 s at the 1.6 s default, 0.2 s at 0.3 s, M: ideas/check/sim/perf_kie_kps_sim.txt). The promised 'overtone melody with one finger' therefore needs a re-pluck every second (swipe to a new column re-plucks, but moving within a column does not) - or the real khomus technique: breath. Players sustain the mouth resonance by breathing in and out across the lamella; add 'atem' (breath noise through the same mouth bandpass, level from Höhe-velocity or a param, ~-25 dB) and the held note lives: tongue decays, the mouth keeps whispering the harmonic, re-pluck on a vertical direction reversal. Selectivity (M): a Q-10 bandpass at harmonic h of a saw rejects the neighbours by only -6.5/-7.5 dB at h = 10 and -4.4/-5.2 dB at h = 14, so the 'melody' is a vowelish blur above h ~6; Q must scale with h (Q = 2h gives -12 dB, 3h -15 dB) - with Q 4-20 as a user param the top of the ladder never reads as a pitch. High notes: at f = 880 Hz, h = 12 puts the mouth at 10.6 kHz, outside any mouth (300-3000 Hz, A); cap h by absolute frequency the way Obertöne caps at 6 kHz (APP 4030) or the Wah turns into hiss on the upper columns. Pitch separation from Obertöne is real (pluck + closing lowpass + klirr partial vs pressed buzz) if the tongue has the metallic 6.27f clang and the 5 ms click; without them it is 'saw into wah'.
soundBurst: Strong: a plucked tongue with a closing lowpass and the mouth at the lane's Höhe is a khomus riff machine; sixteenth notes at 1-2 units of decayMul keep each pluck 100-300 ms, the mouth harmonic jumps per hit (round(2 + obertoene*y)) and reads as a melody over the bordun. Failure: the mouth frequency is set at hit time only; a lane with constant Höhe plays one harmonic forever - the lane needs per-step Höhe (Puls 'Spur-Helligkeit' as the idea says) or a slow mouth walk like Obertöne's walk() buffer to be alive. Second failure: with 4 lanes all on Kiefer the formant jumps cluster into vowel chatter; fine for one or two lanes.
failureModes: No sustain: the held note is silent after ~1 s and the mouth has nothing to shape; add breath excitation ('atem') through the mouth filter and re-pluck on vertical reversal
Mouth Q fixed (4-20) does not separate harmonics above h ~6 (-6.5 dB neighbours at h 10, Q 10; M); scale Q with h (2h-3h)
Mouth harmonic h*f exceeds 3-5 kHz on upper columns (880 Hz x 12 = 10.6 kHz); cap h by absolute frequency as Obertöne does
Without klirr partial, click and a schnarr shaper it is 'sawtooth into wah' - these are mandatory, not options
Puls lane with constant Höhe plays one harmonic forever; needs per-step Höhe or a slow mouth walk
Library confusion with Obertöne (both: harmonic selected by Höhe); the card must say 'gezupft, der Mund wählt' vs 'gepresst, der Strahl wandert'
Release 'closed lips' at 30 ms is a click on a loud tongue; 60-80 ms
verdict: Rare: a physics-based khomus with the mouth on an XY pad already exists on iPhone (Jaw Harp Synth, 2025) and several lip-position apps and Kontakt sets precede it, but none puts the mouth harmonic on finger height over a note grid with tilt and a sequencer lane plucking riffs over a bordun. Native at ~0.5 units (L3 ~1.0). The sketch fails the held-note contract: with no sustain the tongue is -40 dB after about one second and the 'one-finger overtone melody' has nothing left to filter - breath excitation through the mouth (the real khomus technique) and re-pluck on vertical reversal fix it; the mouth Q must scale with the harmonic and the ladder must be capped below ~4 kHz or the upper columns are hiss. The Puls side is the best part: khomus riffs from a lane with per-step Höhe. Build it with those three changes, and ship it only if the klirr partial, click and schnarr are in from day one.
